You will spend more time on high-value activities like optimizing crop rotation cycles based on 50-year climate models and managing the delicate propagation of high-yield varieties. Your expertise is no longer measured by physical endurance, but by your ability to synthesize AI-driven insights into a sustainable and profitable farming strategy.
